ar.title: لحمة راس مقلية

steps.n1: اسلق اللحم سلقاً خفيفاً وصفّه (لحم الراس يُباع دائماً منزوع العظم).
steps.n2: أعده إلى الحلة مع البصل المفروم وحبات الفلفل والملح وماء يغطيه بالكاد، واطهه حتى ينضج.
steps.n4: صفِّ المرقة وثقّلها بالنشا وقدّمها في وعاء منفصل.

en.title: Fried Beef Head Meat (Lahmit al-Ras Ma’liya)
en.intro: Recipe 191, page 87 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Blanch the meat and drain it (head meat is always sold boned).
steps.n2: Return it to the pot with the chopped onion, peppercorns, salt and just enough water to cover, and cook until tender.
steps.n3: Drain the meat and fry it in the oil.
steps.n4: Strain the stock, thicken it with the cornflour and serve it in a separate bowl.

legacySteps: Blanch the meat and drain it (head meat is always sold boned).
Return it to the pot with the chopped onion, peppercorns, salt and just enough water to cover, and cook until tender.
Drain the meat and fry it in the oil.
Strain the stock, thicken it with the cornflour and serve it in a separate bowl.
